answer.rationale: Primary supply contract with low-cost vendor expires in 14 days and that vendor's quote meets the mandated 18% component spend cut alone. Memory c2 records that moving primary supply to this low-cost vendor cut unit cost sharply with quick onboarding and accurate invoicing, so renewing as incumbent keeps integration stable and avoids delivery risk. Assembly line runs at 94% committed volume with no buffer, so deferring or switching primary would increase risk. Verified c2 to confirm performance and c3 to review second-source risk context, but the single allowed decision is to renew primary to minimize total cost without adding risk.
